en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。歌。

p.src: 1  Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

ja: ち、 誓いがあなたに
en: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
u.src: 1  Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

p.src: 2  You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

en: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
u.src: 2  You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

p.src: 3  Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

ja: 々の罪が私を圧倒した。 しかし、あなたは私たちの
en: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
u.src: 3  Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

p.src: 4  Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

ja: いである。 その人はあなたの大庭に住む。 私たちはあなたの
の良いもの、 あなたの
en: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
u.src: 4  Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

p.src: 5  By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

ja: えられる。 あなたは
のすべての果てと、 はるか
にいる者たちの希望である。
en: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
u.src: 5  By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

p.src: 6  By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

en: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
u.src: 6  By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

p.src: 7  You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

en: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
u.src: 7  You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

p.src: 8  They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

ja: む者たちも、あなたの不思議な御業を
en: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
u.src: 8  They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

p.src: 9  You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

ja: は水で満ちている。 あなたはこのように定め、
en: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
u.src: 9  You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

p.src: 10  You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

ja: あなたはその溝を水で満たし、
らかくし、 その作物を
en: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
u.src: 10  You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

p.src: 11  You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

ja: あなたは豊かな実りで年を
en: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
u.src: 11  You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

p.src: 12  The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

ja: 草地にも豊かさがあふれ、
en: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
u.src: 12  The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

p.src: 13  The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

ja: われている。 それらは
びの声を上げ、 また
en: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
u.src: 13  The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
